item.description: The Nathaniel Rogers House at the Bridgehampton Museum launched its 2026 Winter Season with an exhibition celebrating the work of 97-year-old Jack Faragasso. item.title: Riverhead Man Charged with Killing Mother

Curtis Trent Jr., 36, was arrested on Feb. 25 and charged with second-degree murder in Riverhead Town Justice Court in the death of Kathleen Harrison Trent.
